grammar.title: A casual "if" with 的话
grammar.explanation: 的话 (dehuà) means "if" and attaches to the end of the condition clause. It often works together with 如果 at the start, or can be used alone in casual speech.

grammar.title: Long ago with 早就
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 早就 + verb phrase (+ 了)
grammar.explanation: 早就 (zǎojiù) means "already, for a long time, long ago" it emphasizes that something happened well before now, stronger than plain 已经.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ máng dehuà, jiù bú yòng lái le.
sentences.en: If you're busy, you don't need to come.

sentences.zh: 下雨的话，我们就不去了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàyǔ dehuà, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
sentences.en: If it rains, we won't go.

sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，请告诉我。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kěyǐ dehuà, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
sentences.en: If possible, please let me know.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan dehuà, jiù mǎi ba.
sentences.en: If you like it, then buy it.
I've known for a long time.
He left a long time ago.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ zǎojiù wàng le.
sentences.en: I forgot about this a long time ago.

sentences.zh: 她早就不在这儿工作了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǎojiù bú zài zhèr gōngzuò le.
sentences.en: She stopped working here a long time ago.
